title: oomwoo: an open-source robot vacuum you build yourself

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Robot vacuums are usually black boxes, cloud apps, locked firmware, and hardware you can't really fix. Umu is an open- source robot vacuum you build yourself with Raspberry Pi, ROS2, Home Assistant, 2D Liar, ESP32, Arduino, and a 3D printable chassis. The honest part, it's still design stage with the first bill of materials and build docks being validated. That makes it more interesting, not less.
